eligibilityRules: planning envelope contains synthetic assumptions only and no actual user or opportunity record
a later execution candidate must freeze eligible directed dyads before any assignment seed is generated
both roles must independently satisfy the approved trade eligibility and harmful-offer rules
exclusionRules: exclude any real-person identifier from this planning artifact
exclude any dyad crossing a frozen graph partition if that would create unsupported exposure probabilities
exclude any offer with unresolved safety, legality, consent, or baseline-manufacture concerns
interferenceClusterDefinition: connected components or a prespecified graph partition that contains repeated counterparties and material multi-hop spillovers; actual diagnostics are not completed
assignmentDesign: proposed stratified blocked four-arm graph-cluster 2x2 bilateral encouragement policy; synthetic planning only
exposureMapping: map frozen cluster assignment and observed delivery to one of the four registered bilateral encouragement cells; withhold the estimand for unsupported contamination states
potentialOutcomeContrast: mean reviewed counterparty completion under assignment to both_roles minus mean under assignment to neither_role in the frozen eligible graph-cluster population
targetPopulation: a future, separately approved frozen population of eligible directed trade opportunities; this artifact contains no such population
outcomeWindow: proposed fixed 30-day resolution window after assigned invitation delivery; not approved for execution

estimator.family: cluster-level Horvitz-Thompson or Hájek with randomization inference

unequalClusterSizeHandling: use the frozen dyad-weighted Hájek ratio, report cluster-count and dyad-count denominators, and run leave-largest-cluster-out sensitivity
covariateAdjustmentPolicy: unadjusted design-based estimate is primary; any frozen pre-assignment covariate adjustment is precision-only and must not change the estimand
missingnessEstimand: unresolved evidence remains an explicit outcome state; do not silently drop unresolved dyads
attritionBounds: report arm-specific resolution rates and worst-case bounds that assign unresolved dyads to both outcome extremes
sensitivityAnalyses: repeat analysis after excluding each of the five largest clusters in turn
repeat under contamination rates from zero through the prespecified maximum
report worst-case unresolved-evidence bounds by arm
report estimates separately across prespecified baseline-risk and cluster-size strata
fixedHorizonOrSequentialDesign: proposed fixed horizon with no optional stopping; the candidate remains non-executing
participantDefinition: if ever executed, both users in an eligible dyad may be research participants because assignment can alter invitations and relational outcomes; no real participant exists in this artifact
controlConditionJustification: not approved; a future ethics review must determine whether withholding an invitation removes any entitlement or creates differential risk
vulnerableParticipantProtections: exclude minors and any user facing material hierarchical, economic, social, or relational pressure unless indepently approved safeguards exist
debriefingPolicy: not determined; required before execution review if assignment is not fully transparent at enrollment
adverseEventMonitoring: monitor every blocking safety outcome continuously and suspend assignment immediately on any observed or unresolved veto
stopAndSuspensionRules: no launch without adequate independent graph clusters and supported exposure probabilities
suspend on any harmful offer, threat, coercion, retaliation, identity exposure, or baseline manufacture signal
suspend if differential evidence resolution or contamination exceeds its frozen bound
cancel if assignment integrity, eligibility immutability, or code-hash provenance fails
privacyRetentionAndDeletion: not approved for real data; a future plan must minimize identity data, separate research keys, bind retention periods, and honor deletion and legal constraints
accessControl: planning files are repository-readable; any future assignment manifest must use least-privilege service access with no client write path
incidentResponse: fail closed, stop assignment, preserve append-only audit evidence, notify the designated owner and independent reviewer, and do not resume without a new exact authorization
entropySource: no assignment entropy generated for this planning-only candidate
seedGenerationProcedure: after eligibility and graph diagnostics are irreversibly frozen, obtain independently logged entropy once; seed shopping and rerandomization are prohibited
constrainedRandomizationRule: within each frozen stratum, require complete blocks of four clusters and assign exactly one cluster to each arm; an incomplete block is a no-launch error
assignmentConcealment: no assignments exist; a future manifest must remain concealed until eligibility is irreversible and delivery is due
outcomeAdjudicatorBlinding: reviewers should be blinded to assignment where feasible and every unblinding must be append-only logged
differentialEvidenceResolutionAudit: compare resolution, missingness, and adjudicator-unblinding rates by arm before interpreting any outcome contrast
contaminationAndSpilloverMonitoring: measure cross-cluster invitations, repeated counterparties, off-platform communication, and multi-hop exposure; unsupported exposure states withhold the estimand
offPlatformSubstitutionAudit: compare reviewed off-platform completion and substitution signals by arm without treating absence of evidence as no substitution
resourceClaimDeduplication: assign each reviewed outcome a stable claim key and prohibit the same claim from entering more than one additive aggregate
